summary: Frontend-only verification of the 8-item Round-2 ONE-PR (N1..N4, P0-1..P0-4). Verified marketing surfaces (Landing hero/title/footer show 'ORA by Aurem' + legal line), Login and Signup one-line legal footer (data-testid='login-legal-line' / 'signup-legal-line'), Settings page has NO Track Switcher UI (TRACK_SWITCHER_ENABLED=false gate verified — 0 elements with track-switcher testid, no 'Personal Track / Developer Track' toggle text; the read-only 'TRACK: developer' info row in Profile is a separate read-only display, not a switcher), and the DeleteChatConfirmModal delete-chat flow end-to-end from SessionSwitcher (open → Cancel keeps row → Delete removes row 19→18, no native window.confirm dialog fired). Ship button copy verified via code + DOM: ShipDialog renders '🚀 Approve the fix' and disabled-state hint says 'approve fixes' (not 'Ship via CTO'); ShipConfirmModal title is 'Approve the fix'. Remaining 'Ship via CTO' occurrences in source are code comments + a detector regex (non-user-facing). Chat-persona identity check on /ora returned MOCK_LLM canned reply — cannot verify assistant self-identifies as ORA vs AUREM live; flagged NEEDS REAL-MODEL RE-TEST.

context_for_next_testing_agent: MOCK_LLM is active on this preview pod (banner '[MOCK_LLM — no active model yet]' appears in every assistant reply on /ora). Any test that depends on real LLM behavior (chat persona identity, ship-suggestion detection, K1 fallback trigger, loop plan output) will get a canned mock and cannot be validated live here. Flip MOCK_LLM=false and configure a provider before retesting N1 (persona) end-to-end. The main chat with SessionSwitcher lives at /dashboard (v2 TopBar historySlot uses SessionSwitcher), NOT /ora — /ora is OraDirect, a simpler chat with its own testids (ora-input, ora-send, ora-history, ora-settings, ora-logout, suggestion-*).
